initial_rules: FAIL any visible scratch, stain, or surface damage; PASS otherwise.
final_rules: FAIL any visible scratch, stain, or surface damage; PASS otherwise.

rounds.rules: Screw visual inspection SOP: PASS if the screw matches reference type and form with only normal variation. Accept as normal uniform metallic finish with reflections, soft shadows and slight darkening inside thread roots and at the shank-to-thread junction, faint machining lines, and minor brightness or oil sheen from lighting — do not FAIL for gradual shading or reflection that follows the geometry and has no sharp, localized edge. FAIL only for a clearly localized defect that stands out from the surrounding finish and cannot be explained by light or shadow: distinct scratch, cut, crack, pit, dent, rust or dark adhered stain, deformed or bent shank, damaged head, or stripped/missing threads. Inspect the entire head, smooth shank, and threaded section before deciding; do not PASS a part only because overall shape looks correct — if any such localized damage is visible anywhere, FAIL, otherwise PASS.
rounds.rationale: Narrowed FAIL to sharp localized damage unexplained by lighting to prevent false alarms on normal shadows at geometry transitions, while requiring full-surface inspection so true defects are not missed as matching reference.
